fields.description: Read from the visiting card and used on the public page. Change them here if the card was read wrong.
fields.label: Card Colours

fields.description: Colour of the company name on the card. The public page shows the name in this colour.
fields.label: Company Name Colour

fields.description: Main brand or accent colour on the card, used for headings, links and the button on the public page.
fields.label: Brand Colour

fields.description: In the owner's own words: products, services and who you work with. Shown on the public page.
fields.label: What Does Your Business Do?

fields.description: One per line, e.g. "GST filing" or "HDPE pipes". Filled from the website when empty. Tells AI search engines what this business offers.
fields.label: Products & Services

fields.description: The address of this business's public page, made automatically as business/iyp-yy-mm-number (e.g. business/iyp-26-10-00005). The number restarts at 00001 every year.
fields.label: Public Page

fields.description: Click Send Welcome Email at the top to email the public page link and the card to the email above. If Send Welcome Email Automatically is on in Settings, it goes after Save by itself.
fields.label: Welcome Email

fields.description: 2026-11-23: tick when the business has paid (₹1,200 + GST for 10 years). Paid businesses get the page report email every day, others every Monday (page_report.py).
fields.label: Plan

fields.description: Last day of the paid plan. Empty = no end date.
fields.label: Paid Until

fields.description: Your industry or line of business, e.g. HVAC contractor, Interior design, Chartered accountant. Read from the card or website.
fields.label: Segment

fields.description: Shown at the top of the public page. A square logo looks best. Without one, the page shows the company's initials.
fields.label: Company Logo

fields.description: Your page's own ID on It's Your Profile. Set automatically.
fields.label: IYP ID

fields.description: 15 characters, e.g. 27ABCDE1234F1Z5. Shown on your public page.
fields.label: GST Number (GSTIN)

fields.description: 21 characters, for registered companies, e.g. U72200MH2013PTC123456. Shown on your public page.
fields.label: CIN (Company Identification Number)

fields.description: Udyam Registration Number (e.g. UDYAM-MH-26-0012345) or old Udyog Aadhaar (e.g. MH26E0012345). Shown on your public page.
fields.label: Udyam Registration Number (or Udyog Aadhaar)

fields.description: 10-character PAN, e.g. ABCDE1234F. Filled from your GST number if left empty. Shown on your public page.
fields.label: PAN Number

fields.description: Found automatically with a Google search when the Contact Person is filled in. Check it is the right person.
fields.label: Contact Person's LinkedIn

fields.description: Whether the contact person's LinkedIn profile was found. The company's LinkedIn page, if found, is added to Profile Links.
fields.label: LinkedIn Search

fields.description: Off (default): your phone number is public on your page, with Call and WhatsApp buttons. Tick to keep it private: it is hidden from your page, the visiting card picture, Save Contact and what AI reads.
fields.label: Keep my phone number private

fields.description: Optional. Add it if the card has details on the back too.
fields.label: Visiting Card (Back Side)

fields.description: Filled automatically from the address on Save if left empty
fields.label: Google Maps URL

fields.description: LinkedIn, Facebook, Google Profile, BNI or any other page. Links found on the website are added automatically.
fields.label: Profile Links

fields.description: Questions customers ask, answered from this profile's facts. Shown on the page and given to Google and AI search as FAQ data. Written by AI when empty; edit freely.
fields.label: FAQs

fields.description: Ticked when the owner removed every FAQ: the AI then leaves the FAQs empty. Cleared when a FAQ is added again.
fields.label: FAQs Removed by Owner
